El Niño weather pattern to persist until February 2027

The El Niño weather pattern is expected to continue until February 2027, according to the World Meteorological Organization (WMO). This prolonged duration of El Niño has significant implications for India. The WMO's warning indicates a potential intensification of the phenomenon. The persistence of El Niño could affect weather patterns and climate conditions across the country.
